title: Did Tejasswi Prakash Take A Dig At Karan Kundrra's Ex Anusha Dandekar With This Birthday Post? | Television News - News18
text: Television’s ‘IT’ couple Tejasswi Prakash and Karan Kundrra have always been each other’s support system. Fans are also not unaware of their PDA moments. In the latest, Tejasswi made a mushy post on Karan’s birthday and it appeared to be a subtle dig at the ‘cheating’ drama citied by his ex Anusha Dandekar. Reality show personality Anusha claimed on a podcast that her ex-boyfriend cheated on her and it involved a dating app. Now, it seems that Tejasswi’s playful mention of ‘Right Swipe’ in her caption is a direct nod to the matter. Tejasswi Prakash’s Romantic Post The Television superstar shared a romantic photo series with Karan and wished him a belated birthday on Tuesday. “The only right swipe he does now. To the man of my dreams, happy birthday," Tejasswi Prakash wrote, tagging Karan Kundrra who celebrates birthday on October 11. In her carousel, the Naagin 6 actress dropped some of her happy moments with Karan. In one photo, Karan was seen kissing Tejasswi’s forehead against a sparkling backdrop, and in other videos, the two were seen enjoying life while seated inside a car and on a yacht in the middle of the sea. Without naming Karan Kundrra, Anusha Dandekar had said that despite being in a steady relationship, her then-boyfriend flirted with women on a dating app of which they both were the brand ambassadors. Karan Kundrra On Cheating Allegations In a now-deleted post, Karan mentioned, “87 articles in three hours and for what?? To sell a podcast!? Is this the inspiration that’s being instilled into the young boys & girls of our country?? Is this entertainment for you??" The actor further stated, “It’s unfortunate that today these cruel elite women can say ANYTHING and they will be applauded and men like me have nowhere to go, we come from small cities work extremely hard, persevere away from our loved ones and NO one supports till the spark is sucked out of you, your vibrant personality becomes a reminiscence of the past and you end up as a ‘justice for.. hashtag." Tejasswi Prakash-Karan Kundrra’s Relationship Lovebirds Tejasswii and Karan met on the sets of Bigg Boss season 15, and have been together ever since. The couple was last seen on The Laughter Chef, a fun couple reality show.
